literal_meaning: ঘড়িতে বারোটা বাজা (the clock striking twelve)
figurative_meaning_en: to go completely crazy or haywire, often in jest or excitement
example_sentences_in_bangla: খেলার পর সে খুশিতে বারোটা বাজা গেছে।
এই খবর শুনে তার মাথায় বারোটা বাজল।
example_sentences_in_english: After the game, he went completely crazy with joy.
Hearing this news made his head go haywire.
note: The idiom draws from the idea of a clock malfunctioning at midnight, symbolizing loss of control in Bengali vernacular.
